# modes (Ephemeral Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "scaffolding_modes" "example" {
  # arguments here
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project identifier (key)

### Optional

- `config` (Attributes) Configuration block with various modes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `count32` (Number) 32-bit counter
- `count64` (Number) 64-bit counter
- `counters_int64` (List of Number) List of int64 counters
- `enabled` (Boolean) Feature enabled flag
- `flags_int32` (List of Number) List of int32 flags
- `metrics` (Attributes List) List of metrics objects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `provisioning` (Attributes) Provisioning data (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning))
- `ratio` (Number) Floating ratio value
- `secret_payload` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Opaque write-only secret payload

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server assigned ID

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `note` (String) Editable note (default read/write)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Write-only nested secret
- `version` (String) Immutable version string

Read-Only:

- `initial_token` (String) Token only returned at create
- `result` (String) Read-only computed result


<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Required:

- `name` (String) Metric name (key)
- `value_int32` (Number) Sample int32 metric
- `value_int64` (Number) Sample int64 metric

Read-Only:

- `computed_hash` (String) Computed hash of metric


<a id="nestedatt--provisioning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning`

Required:

- `request_id` (String) Client supplied request ID (key)

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Write-only API key

Read-Only:

- `provisioned_id` (String) ID after provisioning (read-only once)
